convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iMA). Simple crossover entry/exit with fixed SL/TP. Fixed lot or risk-fraction sizing. No external .mqh libraries. Straightforward logic easily replicated in Python.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes current position before opening new one in reverse direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If Lots<=0 then risk-fraction mode (OrderValue as percent of margin), else fixed lot size using Lots parameter

custom_logic_notes: EA uses Stop-and-Reverse pattern: when an opposite signal fires, the existing position is closed first and then a new position in the reverse direction is opened immediately. Trailing stop is optional (defaults to 0=disabled). Digit adjustment multiplies SL/TP/Trail by 10 for 5/3-digit brokers. Margin check performed before order placement. Free mode (Lots<=0) calculates lot size based on OrderValue percent of free margin.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward EMA crossover system. Use pandas EWM for EMA calculation. Digit adjustment logic maps to adjusting SL/TP by price precision. The SAR (stop-and-reverse) pattern means always in market when signal fires—close opposite then enter new. Position sizing has dual mode: fixed lots vs margin-percent calculation—implement both branches. New bar detection needed to prevent repeated signals within same bar. Previous bar EMA values (shift=1) used for crossover detection to avoid repainting.
